caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet, primarily colored in light yellow and green. The bonnet has a rounded, textured crown with visible segmented stitching. A wide, green ribbon with pink undertones is wrapped around the bonnet and tied in a bow under the chin, with the ends hanging downward. The ribbon is illustrated with shading to show folds and curves. The main image of the bonnet with the ribbon is rendered in color and occupies the upper left portion of the page. On the right side of the drawing, there are two smaller, less detailed sketches of the same bonnet in pencil only, showing front and back views, highlighting the general structure and placement of the ribbons without color or shading. The background is a solid off-white color, and the drawing is composed on a plain sheet with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Bonnet
